57  /**
58   * External test parameter load template for PostgreSQL.
59   */
60  public final class PostgreSQLExternalTestParameterLoadTemplate implements ExternalTestParameterLoadTemplate {
61      
62      @Override
63      public Collection<ExternalSQLTestParameter> load(final String sqlCaseFileName, final List<String> sqlCaseFileContent,
64                                                       final List<String> resultFileContent, final String databaseType, final String reportType) {
65          List<ScriptStatement> statements = new ScriptReader(sqlCaseFileContent, databaseType).read();
66          int[] echoes = findEchoes(statements, resultFileContent);
67          Collection<ExternalSQLTestParameter> result = new ArrayList<>(statements.size());
68          for (int i = 0; i < statements.size(); i++) {
69              ScriptStatement statement = statements.get(i);
70              if (!statement.sql.isEmpty() && !hasNativeError(statement, i, echoes, resultFileContent)) {
71                  result.add(new ExternalSQLTestParameter(sqlCaseFileName + (result.size() + 1), databaseType, statement.sql, reportType));
72              }
73          }
74          return result;
75      }
76      
77      private int[] findEchoes(final List<ScriptStatement> statements, final List<String> expectedLines) {
78          Map<String, List<Integer>> linePositions = IntStream.range(0, expectedLines.size()).boxed().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(expectedLines::get));
79          Map<List<String>, Integer> occurrences = statements.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(each -> each.echo, each -> 1, Integer::sum));
80          Map<List<String>, Iterator<Integer>> matches = occurrences.entrySet().stream()
81                  .collect(Collectors.toMap(Entry::getKey, entry -> matchEcho(entry.getKey(), linePositions, expectedLines, entry.getValue()).iterator()));
82          int[] result = new int[statements.size()];
83          Arrays.fill(result, -1);
84          int cursor = 0;
85          for (int i = 0; i < statements.size(); i++) {
86              List<String> echo = statements.get(i).echo;
87              Iterator<Integer> positions = matches.get(echo);
88              int position = positions.hasNext() ? positions.next() : -1;
89              if (position >= cursor) {
90                  result[i] = position;
91                  cursor = result[i] + echo.size();
92              }
93          }
94          return result;
95      }
96      
97      private List<Integer> matchEcho(final List<String> echo, final Map<String, List<Integer>> linePositions, final List<String> expectedLines, final int occurrences) {
98          Collection<Integer> positions = linePositions.getOrDefault(echo.get(0), Collections.emptyList());
99          List<Integer> result = positions.stream().mapToInt(each -> each)
100                 .filter(each -> each + echo.size() <= expectedLines.size() && expectedLines.subList(each, each + echo.size()).equals(echo)).boxed().collect(Collectors.toList());
101         return result.size() == occurrences ? result : Collections.emptyList();
102     }
103     
104     private boolean hasNativeError(final ScriptStatement statement, final int index, final int[] echoes, final List<String> expectedLines) {
105         if (!statement.filterable || echoes[index] < 0 || index + 1 < echoes.length && echoes[index + 1] < 0) {
106             return false;
107         }
108         int end = index + 1 == echoes.length ? expectedLines.size() : echoes[index + 1];
109         for (int i = echoes[index] + statement.echo.size(); i < end; i++) {
110             String line = expectedLines.get(i);
111             if (line.startsWith("NOTICE:") || line.startsWith("WARNING:") || line.startsWith("INFO:") || line.startsWith("LOG:") || line.startsWith("DEBUG:")) {
112                 return false;
113             }
114             if (line.startsWith("ERROR:")) {
115                 return true;
116             }
117         }
118         return false;
119     }

121     @RequiredArgsConstructor
122     private static final class ScriptStatement {
123         
124         private final String sql;
125         
126         private final List<String> echo;
127         
128         private final boolean filterable;
129     }

131     private static final class ScriptReader extends BaseErrorListener {
132         
133         private static final Pattern PSQL_VARIABLE_PATTERN =
134                 Pattern.compile(":(?:[A-Za-z_0-9\\x80-\\uFFFF]+|'[A-Za-z_0-9\\x80-\\uFFFF]+'|\"[A-Za-z_0-9\\x80-\\uFFFF]+\"|\\{\\?[A-Za-z_0-9\\x80-\\uFFFF]+\\})");
135         
136         private final List<String> lines;
137         
138         private final DatabaseType databaseType;
139         
140         private final CharStream input;
141         
142         private final Lexer lexer;
143         
144         private final int[] lineStarts;
145         
146         private final boolean[] quotedLines;
147         
148         private final List<ScriptStatement> statements = new ArrayList<>();
149         
150         private final Deque<ConditionalBlock> conditionals = new ArrayDeque<>();
151         
152         private final StringBuilder normalizedSQL = new StringBuilder();
153         
154         private int conditionalStart = -1;
155         
156         private int conditionalStatementStart;
157         
158         private int conditionalReplayEnd;
159         
160         private boolean conditionalEchoAll;
161         
162         private boolean conditionalFallback;
163         
164         private int start = -1;
165         
166         private int variableEnd = -1;
167         
168         private int parentheses;
169         
170         private int jsonObjectParentheses;
171         
172         private int brackets;
173         
174         private int atomicBlocks;
175         
176         private int caseBlocks;
177         
178         private String previousKind = "";
179         
180         private boolean firstToken = true;
181         
182         private boolean copyStatement;
183         
184         private boolean copyOutput;
185         
186         private boolean pendingCopy;
187         
188         private boolean unsafe;
189         
190         private boolean clientBuffer;
191         
192         private boolean clientStatement;
193         
194         private boolean emptyQuotedIdentifier;
195         
196         private boolean echoAll = true;
197         
198         private boolean clientStateKnown = true;
199         
200         private ScriptReader(final List<String> lines, final String databaseType) {
201             this.lines = lines;
202             this.databaseType = TypedSPILoader.getService(DatabaseType.class, databaseType);
203             input = CodePointCharStream.fromBuffer(CodePointBuffer.withChars(CharBuffer.wrap(String.join("\n", lines).toCharArray())));
204             lexer = createLexer(input);
205             lexer.addErrorListener(this);
206             lineStarts = new int[lines.size()];
207             quotedLines = new boolean[lines.size()];
208             for (int i = 1; i < lineStarts.length; i++) {
209                 lineStarts[i] = lineStarts[i - 1] + lines.get(i - 1).length() + 1;
210             }
211         }
212         
213         @SneakyThrows(ReflectiveOperationException.class)
214         private Lexer createLexer(final CharStream characters) {
215             Lexer result = (Lexer) DatabaseTypedSPILoader.getService(DialectSQLParserFacade.class, databaseType).getLexerClass().getConstructor(CharStream.class).newInstance(characters);
216             result.removeErrorListener(ConsoleErrorListener.INSTANCE);
217             return result;
218         }
219         
220         private List<ScriptStatement> read() {
221             for (Token token = lexer.nextToken();; token = lexer.nextToken()) {
222                 if (Token.EOF == token.getType()) {
223                     if (conditionalStart >= 0) {
224                         rewindConditional(input.size());
225                         continue;
226                     }
227                     break;
228                 }
229                 markQuotedLines(token);
230                 if (Token.DEFAULT_CHANNEL != token.getChannel()) {
231                     if (start < 0) {
232                         statements.add(new ScriptStatement("", getEcho(lineAt(token.getStartIndex()), lineAt(token.getStopIndex())), false));
233                     }
234                     continue;
235                 }
236                 String kind = lexer.getVocabulary().getSymbolicName(token.getType());
237                 if ("DQ_".equals(kind) || "IDENTIFIER_".equals(kind) && '"' == input.LA(1) && '"' == input.LA(token.getStartIndex() - input.index())) {
238                     readQuotedIdentifier(token);
239                 }
240                 if ("BACKSLASH_".equals(kind) && readCommand(token.getStartIndex())) {
241                     continue;
242                 }
243                 if (start < 0) {
244                     start = token.getStartIndex();
245                 }
246                 readBlock(kind, token);
247                 if (!isInactive()) {
248                     readCopy(kind);
249                 }
250                 previousKind = "IDENTIFIER_".equals(kind) && isJsonObjectConstructor(token) ? "JSON_OBJECT" : kind;
251                 if ("COLON_".equals(kind)) {
252                     unsafe = true;
253                     if (!isInactive() && 0 == brackets && 0 == jsonObjectParentheses) {
254                         readClientVariable(token.getStartIndex());
255                     }
256                 }
257                 if ("SEMI_".equals(kind) && (clientBuffer || 0 == parentheses && 0 == atomicBlocks)) {
258                     submit(token.getStopIndex() + 1, token.getStopIndex() + 1, true);
259                 }
260             }
261             if (start >= 0) {
262                 submit(input.size(), input.size(), 0 == parentheses && 0 == atomicBlocks);
263             }
264             return statements;
265         }
266         
267         private void rewindConditional(final int end) {
268             statements.subList(conditionalStatementStart, statements.size()).clear();
269             reset();
270             conditionals.clear();
271             echoAll = conditionalEchoAll;
272             conditionalReplayEnd = end;
273             Arrays.fill(quotedLines, lineAt(conditionalStart), lineAt(end - 1) + 1, false);
274             lexer.reset();
275             seek(conditionalStart);
276             conditionalStart = -1;
277         }
278         
279         private void markQuotedLines(final Token token) {
280             if (lexer.getLine() > token.getLine()) {
281                 int lastLine = lineAt(token.getStopIndex());
282                 for (int i = token.getLine(); i <= lastLine; i++) {
283                     quotedLines[i] = true;
284                 }
285             }
286         }
287         
288         private void readQuotedIdentifier(final Token token) {
289             clientStateKnown = false;
290             input.seek(token.getStartIndex() + 1);
291             boolean empty = true;
292             boolean closed = false;
293             while (Token.EOF != input.LA(1)) {
294                 int character = input.LA(1);
295                 input.consume();
296                 if ('"' == character) {
297                     if ('"' != input.LA(1)) {
298                         closed = true;
299                         break;
300                     }
301                     input.consume();
302                 }
303                 empty = false;
304             }
305             if (closed && empty) {
306                 emptyQuotedIdentifier = true;
307             }
308             int lastLine = lineAt(input.index() - 1);
309             for (int i = token.getLine(); i <= lastLine; i++) {
310                 quotedLines[i] = true;
311             }
312             seek(input.index());
313         }
314         
315         private List<String> getEcho(final int firstLine, final int lastLine) {
316             return IntStream.rangeClosed(firstLine, lastLine).filter(i -> !lines.get(i).isEmpty() || quotedLines[i]).mapToObj(lines::get).collect(Collectors.toList());
317         }
318         
319         private boolean readCommand(final int offset) {
320             int line = lineAt(offset);
321             int end = lineStarts[line] + lines.get(line).length();
322             String command = input.getText(Interval.of(offset + 1, end - 1));
323             String name = command.split("\\s|\\\\", 2)[0];
324             boolean compoundCommand = command.indexOf('\\') >= 0;
325             if (compoundCommand && (!conditionals.isEmpty() || command.contains("\\if"))) {
326                 if (conditionalStart >= 0) {
327                     rewindConditional(input.size());
328                     return true;
329                 }
330                 conditionalReplayEnd = input.size();
331             }
332             if (offset >= conditionalReplayEnd && readConditional(name, command, offset, end, compoundCommand)) {
333                 return true;
334             }
335             if (isInactive()) {
336                 if (start >= 0) {
337                     submit(offset, end, false);
338                 } else {
339                     statements.add(new ScriptStatement("", lines.subList(line, line + 1), false));
340                 }
341                 seek(Math.min(input.size(), end + 1));
342                 return true;
343             }
344             if (command.startsWith(";")) {
345                 unsafe = true;
346                 clientBuffer = true;
347                 clientStatement = true;
348                 firstToken = true;
349                 previousKind = "";
350                 seek(offset + 2);
351                 return true;
352             }
353             if (start >= 0 && compoundCommand) {
354                 unsafe = true;
355                 clientBuffer = true;
356                 clientStatement = true;
357                 return false;
358             }
359             if (compoundCommand && !"copy".equals(name)) {
360                 clientStateKnown = false;
361             }
362             if (Arrays.asList("g", "gx", "gset", "gexec").contains(name)) {
363                 boolean copy = pendingCopy;
364                 if (start >= 0) {
365                     submit(offset, end, "g".equals(command.trim()) || "gset".equals(command.trim()));
366                 } else {
367                     statements.add(new ScriptStatement("", lines.subList(line, line + 1), false));
368                 }
369                 if (!copy) {
370                     seek(Math.min(input.size(), end + 1));
371                 }
372                 return true;
373             }
374             if (start >= 0) {
375                 unsafe = true;
376                 clientBuffer = true;
377                 clientStatement = true;
378                 return false;
379             }
380             if ("copy".equals(name)) {
381                 start = offset;
382                 unsafe = true;
383                 clientStatement = true;
384                 boolean copy = isCopyFromStdin(command);
385                 pendingCopy = copy;
386                 submit(end, end, false);
387                 if (!copy) {
388                     seek(Math.min(input.size(), end + 1));
389                 }
390                 return true;
391             }
392             statements.add(new ScriptStatement("", lines.subList(line, line + 1), false));
393             if (command.startsWith("set ECHO ")) {
394                 echoAll = "all".equals(command.substring("set ECHO ".length()).trim());
395             } else if (!Arrays.asList("echo", "qecho").contains(name)) {
396                 clientStateKnown = false;
397             }
398             seek(Math.min(input.size(), end + 1));
399             return true;
400         }
401         
402         private boolean readConditional(final String name, final String command, final int offset, final int end, final boolean compoundCommand) {
403             if (!Arrays.asList("if", "elif", "else", "endif").contains(name)) {
404                 return false;
405             }
406             int line = lineAt(offset);
407             boolean standalone = !compoundCommand && !clientBuffer && input.getText(Interval.of(lineStarts[line], offset - 1)).trim().isEmpty();
408             boolean inactive = isInactive();
409             if ("if".equals(name)) {
410                 int condition = readCondition(command.substring(name.length()).trim());
411                 boolean unknown = !standalone || start >= 0 && !inactive || condition < 0 || !conditionals.isEmpty() && conditionals.peek().unknown;
412                 if (conditionals.isEmpty() && !unknown) {
413                     conditionalStart = lineStarts[line];
414                     conditionalStatementStart = statements.size();
415                     conditionalEchoAll = echoAll;
416                     conditionalFallback = false;
417                 }
418                 ConditionalBlock block = new ConditionalBlock(inactive);
419                 block.unknown = unknown;
420                 block.matched = !unknown && 1 == condition;
421                 block.inactive = inactive || !unknown && 0 == condition;
422                 conditionals.push(block);
423             } else if (conditionals.isEmpty()) {
424                 return false;
425             } else {
426                 ConditionalBlock block = conditionals.peek();
427                 if (("else".equals(name) || "endif".equals(name)) && !command.substring(name.length()).trim().isEmpty() || block.elseBranch && !"endif".equals(name)) {
428                     conditionalFallback = true;
429                 }
430                 if ("endif".equals(name)) {
431                     conditionals.pop();
432                 } else if ("else".equals(name)) {
433                     block.inactive = block.parentInactive || !block.unknown && block.matched;
434                     block.elseBranch = true;
435                 } else {
436                     int condition = block.matched ? 0 : readCondition(command.substring(name.length()).trim());
437                     block.unknown |= condition < 0;
438                     block.inactive = block.parentInactive || !block.unknown && (block.matched || 0 == condition);
439                     block.matched |= !block.unknown && 1 == condition;
440                 }
441             }
442             if (conditionalStart < 0) {
443                 return false;
444             }
445             if (!standalone || start >= 0 && !inactive) {
446                 conditionalFallback = true;
447             }
448             if (conditionals.isEmpty() && conditionalFallback) {
449                 rewindConditional(Math.min(input.size(), end + 1));
450                 return true;
451             }
452             if (start >= 0) {
453                 if (inactive) {
454                     statements.add(new ScriptStatement("", getEcho(lineAt(start), line - 1), false));
455                 }
456                 reset();
457             }
458             statements.add(new ScriptStatement("", lines.subList(line, line + 1), false));
459             clientStateKnown = false;
460             if (conditionals.isEmpty()) {
461                 conditionalStart = -1;
462             }
463             seek(Math.min(input.size(), end + 1));
464             return true;
465         }
466         
467         private boolean isInactive() {
468             return !conditionals.isEmpty() && conditionals.peek().inactive;
469         }
470         
471         private int readCondition(final String expression) {
472             String value = expression.toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH);
473             if (!value.isEmpty() && ("true".startsWith(value) || "yes".startsWith(value) || "on".equals(value) || "1".equals(value))) {
474                 return 1;
475             }
476             if (!value.isEmpty() && ("false".startsWith(value) || "no".startsWith(value) || "off".startsWith(value) && value.length() > 1 || "0".equals(value))) {
477                 return 0;
478             }
479             return -1;
480         }
481         
482         private boolean isCopyFromStdin(final String command) {
483             Lexer header = createLexer(CodePointCharStream.fromBuffer(CodePointBuffer.withChars(CharBuffer.wrap(command.toCharArray()))));
484             int depth = 0;
485             boolean from = false;
486             for (Token token = header.nextToken(); Token.EOF != token.getType(); token = header.nextToken()) {
487                 if (Token.DEFAULT_CHANNEL != token.getChannel()) {
488                     continue;
489                 }
490                 String kind = header.getVocabulary().getSymbolicName(token.getType());
491                 if ("LP_".equals(kind)) {
492                     depth++;
493                 } else if ("RP_".equals(kind)) {
494                     depth--;
495                 } else if (0 == depth && "STDIN".equals(kind) && from) {
496                     return true;
497                 }
498                 from = "FROM".equals(kind);
499             }
500             return false;
501         }
502         
503         private void seek(final int offset) {
504             input.seek(offset);
505             if (offset < input.size()) {
506                 int line = lineAt(offset);
507                 lexer.setLine(line + 1);
508                 lexer.setCharPositionInLine(offset - lineStarts[line]);
509             }
510         }
511         
512         private int lineAt(final int offset) {
513             int index = Arrays.binarySearch(lineStarts, offset);
514             return index >= 0 ? index : -index - 2;
515         }
516         
517         private void readBlock(final String kind, final Token token) {
518             if ("LP_".equals(kind) || "RP_".equals(kind)) {
519                 readParentheses(kind);
520             } else if ("LBT_".equals(kind)) {
521                 brackets++;
522             } else if ("RBT_".equals(kind) && brackets > 0) {
523                 brackets--;
524             } else if ("BEGIN".equals(previousKind) && "ATOMIC".equalsIgnoreCase(token.getText())) {
525                 atomicBlocks++;
526             } else if (atomicBlocks > 0 && "CASE".equals(kind)) {
527                 caseBlocks++;
528             } else if (atomicBlocks > 0 && "END".equals(kind)) {
529                 if (caseBlocks > 0) {
530                     caseBlocks--;
531                 } else {
532                     atomicBlocks--;
533                 }
534             }
535         }
536         
537         private void readParentheses(final String kind) {
538             if ("LP_".equals(kind)) {
539                 parentheses++;
540                 if (0 == jsonObjectParentheses && ("JSON_OBJECT".equals(previousKind) || "JSON_OBJECTAGG".equals(previousKind))) {
541                     jsonObjectParentheses = parentheses;
542                 }
543             } else if (parentheses > 0) {
544                 if (jsonObjectParentheses == parentheses) {
545                     jsonObjectParentheses = 0;
546                 }
547                 parentheses--;
548             }
549         }
550         
551         private void readCopy(final String kind) {
552             if (firstToken) {
553                 copyStatement = "COPY".equals(kind);
554                 firstToken = false;
555             }
556             if (copyStatement && 0 == parentheses && "FROM".equals(previousKind) && "STDIN".equals(kind)) {
557                 pendingCopy = true;
558             }
559             if (copyStatement && 0 == parentheses && "TO".equals(previousKind) && "STDOUT".equals(kind)) {
560                 copyOutput = true;
561             }
562         }
563         
564         private boolean isJsonObjectConstructor(final Token token) {
565             String identifier = token.getText();
566             return "JSON_OBJECT".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier) || "JSON_OBJECTAGG".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier);
567         }
568         
569         private void readClientVariable(final int offset) {
570             int line = lineAt(offset);
571             Matcher matcher = PSQL_VARIABLE_PATTERN.matcher(lines.get(line)).region(offset - lineStarts[line], lines.get(line).length());
572             if (!matcher.lookingAt()) {
573                 return;
574             }
575             String variable = matcher.group();
576             String replacement;
577             switch (variable.charAt(1)) {
578                 case '\'':
579                     replacement = "'foo'";
580                     break;
581                 case '"':
582                     replacement = "\"foo\"";
583                     break;
584                 case '{':
585                     replacement = "TRUE";
586                     break;
587                 default:
588                     clientStatement = true;
589                     seek(offset + variable.length());
590                     return;
591             }
592             normalizedSQL.append(input.getText(Interval.of(variableEnd < 0 ? start : variableEnd, offset - 1))).append(replacement);
593             variableEnd = offset + variable.length();
594             seek(variableEnd);
595         }
596         
597         private void submit(final int sqlEnd, final int echoEnd, final boolean filterable) {
598             int end = sqlEnd;
599             int firstLine = lineAt(start);
600             int lastLine = lineAt(echoEnd - 1);
601             boolean exclusive = input.getText(Interval.of(lineStarts[firstLine], start - 1)).trim().isEmpty()
602                     && input.getText(Interval.of(echoEnd, lineStarts[lastLine] + lines.get(lastLine).length() - 1)).trim().isEmpty();
603             if (pendingCopy) {
604                 int marker = IntStream.range(lastLine + 1, lines.size()).filter(i -> "\\.".equals(lines.get(i))).findFirst().orElse(-1);
605                 if (marker < 0) {
606                     end = input.size();
607                     unsafe = true;
608                     seek(input.size());
609                 } else {
610                     seek(Math.min(input.size(), lineStarts[marker] + lines.get(marker).length() + 1));
611                 }
612             }
613             statements.add(new ScriptStatement(getSQL(end), getEcho(firstLine, lastLine), filterable && exclusive && !unsafe && !copyOutput && echoAll && clientStateKnown));
614             reset();
615         }
616         
617         private String getSQL(final int end) {
618             if (isInactive() || clientStatement || emptyQuotedIdentifier) {
619                 return "";
620             }
621             if (variableEnd < 0) {
622                 return input.getText(Interval.of(start, end - 1)).trim();
623             }
624             return normalizedSQL.append(input.getText(Interval.of(variableEnd, end - 1))).toString().trim();
625         }
626         
627         private void reset() {
628             start = -1;
629             variableEnd = -1;
630             normalizedSQL.setLength(0);
